about: Chronic constipation was present during the amitriptyline course and had resolved by the June follow-up.

Possible finding: the record holds no line about dementia, glaucoma, heart rhythm, prostate, bowel, falls, bladder or blood pressure problems. Nortriptyline (Allegron, a tricyclic antidepressant) is supplied every month for 7 months.
The March review excludes all listed conditions during amitriptyline treatment, and orthostatic hypotension first began in April.
